summary: Silvaco Group filed an 8-K disclosing an amendment to its existing at-the-market (ATM) offering program. The company increased the aggregate offering amount from $15 million to $35 million by filing a prospectus supplement. As of May 7, 2026, roughly $4.3 million of shares had already been sold, leaving up to $30.67 million available for sale. The filing notes that due to an increase in public float above $75 million, the company is no longer subject to the baby shelf limitation and can now sell additional securities under General Instruction I.B.1. This is a routine capital markets update, not a special situation event.
